I fixed the bug in `src/invoice.py`. I couldn't run the tests, so CI needs to confirm the fix.

- **Cause:** `tax()` used `math.floor`, which truncates the result. FIN-12, which the test cites, requires rounding half up to the cent.
- **Fix:** `tax()` now uses `Decimal` with `ROUND_HALF_UP`. Going through `Decimal(str(...))` avoids float error. For this test, 112.50 × 0.09 = 10.125, which rounds to 10.13.
- **Test:** I didn't change it. It matches the policy.
- **Effect on other code:** Taxes that were previously truncated will now round up in some cases, by at most 1 cent. This is the intended FIN-12 behavior. I only had the three repo files to look at, so I didn't check whether anything else calls `tax()`.
